_doc: EDGE-MATRIX 2026-07-23 -- FROZEN pre-registration for the FULL-HISTORY re-run of family bull-level-reclaim-quality. Grid cells and the immutable 4-gate ship bar are copied VERBATIM from the v1 prereg (prereg-bull-level-reclaim-quality-2026-07-23.json); ONLY the population changes (381 -> 386 opra_days after the 2026-07-22 OPRA backfill amendment) and held-out is recomputed from the full list per the re-run directive. Changing cells or gates on a re-run is methodology-shopping and disqualifies the run. Honest null expected and valued.
shared_protocol: edge-matrix 2026-07-23 (FOCUS-DOCTRINE.md lens; DOJO-HARVEST-2026-07-21.md incl. retraction read before authoring)

detector_definition_fixed.level_source: backtest/lib/watchers/level_memory.py LevelMemory -- the LIVE engine's multi-day level perception layer. lookback_days=5 (module DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS), memory_score >= 20.0 (the producer's MIN_MEMORY selection floor, cited in level_memory.py's own T7 commentary -- reused, not invented). Never an invented level set.
detector_definition_fixed.reclaim_event: At 5m bar i (RTH): take the level set from LevelMemory.levels_at(i-1) built on a window of the prior 4 covered days + today up to bar i-1 (STRICTLY causal -- the level set, roles, and memory scores are frozen as of the PRIOR closed bar). A level qualifies if role=='resistance' as of i-1 AND close[i-1] <= level.price (price genuinely below/at the level). The reclaim fires when close[i] > level.price + zone_band (the bar CLOSES above the zone top -- zones, never penny-exact). zone_band is grid axis 1.
detector_definition_fixed.causality: bar i uses only bars <= i (C6). Levels/roles from bars <= i-1; the trigger close is bar i's own close, known at bar close time. Enforced by an in-code truncation spot-check assertion (re-derive a sample of signals on frames truncated at the signal bar; identical result required).
detector_definition_fixed.cooldown: 6 bars (30 min) per level price per cell -- a re-fire of the same level inside the cooldown is dropped (dedupe of the same reclaim, fixed constant).
detector_definition_fixed.entry_window_et: trigger-bar START time in [09:35, 15:30] true ET (live 09:35 entry gate; 15:30 cutoff leaves room before the 15:40 time stop).
detector_definition_fixed.one_position_at_a_time: Per cell per day, signals are executed sequentially; a signal whose trigger falls before the prior trade's exit time is skipped (mirrors the live engine's single-position mechanics and the FOCUS one-good-trade cadence). n_signals counts post-cooldown detector signals; n_real_fills counts executed, non-overlapping, real-OPRA-filled trades.
detector_definition_fixed.timestamp_frame: et-v2 (per-row offset -> UTC -> America/New_York, DST-correct) on BOTH the SPY caches and the OPRA option cache -- frame-consistent joins per backtest/lib/et_frame.py; never a wall-v1/et-v2 mix.

quality_conditioning_provenance.rsi_cap_68: J 2026-07-21 ruling on the 12:21 entry ('in what world is that an entry? The move is already happening'): RSI(14) was 68.8 -- textbook 70 would NOT have caught it (DOJO-HARVEST Lane B #2). The good 11:15 entry read 63.6. Cap 68 blocks 68.8, passes 63.6. n=1-day provenance -- which is exactly why it is a grid knob under a frozen ship bar, not a rule.
quality_conditioning_provenance.rsi_reset_55_within_12: J contrast: the great 11:15 entry 'came right after RSI reset to 50.8 at 11:00'. Reset := min RSI(14) over bars [i-12, i] (60 min) <= 55. Thresholds fixed at authoring time from that worked example; binary require/not is the knob.
quality_conditioning_provenance.dist_cap_3_50: J's extension read: 12:21 was +$4.40 off the session low (bad), 11:15 was +$3.23 (good). Cap 3.50 sits between them: blocks 4.40, passes 3.23. dist := close[i] - min(RTH low from 09:30 through bar i).
quality_conditioning_provenance.rsi_impl: Wilder RSI(14) on the CONTINUOUS multi-day 5m close series (no per-day reset), backtest/autoresearch/rsi_extension_block_probe.py::_wilder_rsi -- reused, not re-derived. ewm is causal.

grid.note: Full factorial 2x2x2x2. The (cap=none, reset=off, dist=none) cells ARE the raw-reclaim control -- the family question is answered by comparing conditioned cells against them, not by tuning.

execution_fixed.strike: ATM per live Safe tier -- setup/scripts/dojo/sim_executor._strike_for on accounts.json arm 'safe-2' (crypto/lib/strike_selection.py V15_SAFE_TIERS path), spot = trigger bar close.
execution_fixed.entry_fill: next 5m OPRA bar VWAP at/after trigger-bar close time (trigger start + 5 min) via backtest/lib/option_pricing_real.bar_at_or_after -- real fills only.
execution_fixed.exit_shape: the LIVE RIBBON_RIDE shape via the live merge (sim_executor._resolve_exit_shape(arm 'safe-2', 'ribbon_ride', None)): premium_stop_pct -0.20 (flag-off fallback), tp1 +100% sell 0.667, trailing 15% off HWM, runner_target 99.0, stop_mode structure, catastrophe -0.50.
execution_fixed.trigger_level: zone_low = level.price - zone_band (the reclaimed zone's bottom; a closed 5m SPY close back below it invalidates the reclaim).
execution_fixed.exit_walk: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager -- the REAL production exit_manager decision core. Entry-side tuning ONLY; no exit knob is on the grid.
execution_fixed.ribbon: backtest/lib/ribbon.compute_ribbon over the full continuous close series (proper EMA warmup), 'stack' aligned to option bars via sim_executor._ribbon_aligned_to.

gates.gate_2: day majority: day-total P&L > 0 on a strict majority of covered days with >=1 real fill
gates.gate_3: survives ex-top-1: total_pnl minus the single best trade > 0
gates.gate_4: held-out positive: total P&L on held-out days > 0 with >=1 held-out fill
gates.p_raw: one-sample t vs zero on per-trade P&L (normal-approx, same convention as pullback_hold_bull_replay._one_sample_p)
gates.ex_top3_total: total_pnl minus the sum of the 3 best trades (disclosure metric, not a gate)

population.inventory: analysis/edge-matrix/day-inventory-2026-07-23.json (built 2026-07-22, amended 2026-07-22 by _amend_day_inventory_opra_gap.py: +5 opra days 2026-07-15/16/20/21/22 after the OPRA backfill, 381 -> 386).
population.context_days: all 386 covered days feed level/RSI/ribbon context (lookback only).
population.signal_and_dollar_days: ALL 386 opra_days (2025-01-02..2026-07-22) -- signals are counted and dollars computed ONLY on these. Days whose pinned SPY source yields <30 RTH bars at load time are dropped and DISCLOSED by date in the results file (loading seam, not detector logic).
population.held_out: RECOMPUTED from the full amended opra_days list: last ceil(25%) by date = 97 days, 2026-03-03..2026-07-22. The inventory's stored heldout_days (96 days, 2026-02-25..2026-07-17) predates the 5-day amendment and is superseded FOR THIS RUN ONLY, per the fullhist re-run directive ('recompute from the full list'). The grid is frozen here and run ONCE -- no tuning iteration reads held-out results.
population.amended_day_tags_disclosure: The 5 amended opra days (2026-07-15/16/20/21/22) carry day_type/vix_band tags computed by the ORIGINAL inventory build's SPY+VIX pipeline (the amendment flipped only has_opra/n_opra_files); they are used as-is for the regime/vix disclosure splits. Separately, the first 5 covered days (2025-01-02..2025-01-08) have day_type='unclassified' (no ATR20 warmup) -- they appear in the vix_band split normally and in no day_type-based split.
population.synthetic_policy: NO BS-synthetic pricing anywhere in this study. A signal whose ATM contract CSV is absent from backtest/data/options/ is recorded status=NO_OPTION_DATA, disclosed in counts, excluded from all gate math.

regime_split_disclosure.purpose: DISCLOSURE of which regimes carry each cell's result -- NOT a new gate; gate math is unchanged from v1.
regime_split_disclosure.vix_band_split: per cell: inventory vix_band tag of the fill's day (low/mid/elevated/high; 'untagged' bucket if absent) -- each {n, total_pnl}.

no_post_hoc_tuning: Grid, constants, population, held-out list, and gates are fixed at this file's write time. The runner may not adjust any of these after seeing results; any changed definition requires a new dated pre-reg.
